import unittest
from priority_slot import insertion_slot

class PrioritySlot(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_scalar_probe_and_left_edge(self):
        rows = [{'id': 'A', 'priority': 4}, {'id': 'B', 'priority': 9},
                {'id': 'C', 'priority': 9}, {'id': 'D', 'priority': 14}]
        before = [dict(row) for row in rows]
        self.assertEqual(insertion_slot(rows, 9), 1)
        self.assertEqual(insertion_slot(rows, 12), 3)
        self.assertEqual(insertion_slot(rows, 4), 0)
        self.assertEqual(rows, before)

    def test_extremes_and_empty_sequence(self):
        rows = [{'priority': -3}, {'priority': 2}, {'priority': 2}]
        self.assertEqual(insertion_slot(rows, -10), 0)
        self.assertEqual(insertion_slot(rows, 8), 3)
        self.assertEqual(insertion_slot(rows, 2), 1)
        self.assertEqual(insertion_slot([], 8), 0)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
